metric: Activities seen out of the full list

metric: Frames where a person was detected
what_it_means: The camera looks straight down, so people appear as head and shoulders and are usually missed. Anything counting technicians is unreliable.
It measures 'nothing moved'. Someone standing still to tighten bolts looks the same as an empty bay, so treat waiting as a worst case.

metric: Is 'wheels off' vs 'tyres on' actually measured?
what_it_means: The time on the lift is measured, but splitting it into removal and fitting is an assumption. Gap timings are real; which half they fall in is not.
Tyre 1-4 rows divide the lift time into equal slices. The wheels on the car are never visible from above, so individual tyres cannot be timed.
